id: Unique number that identifies the service request in the booking system.
name: Short title the requester gave to the service request.
state: Current stage of the request in the core facility workflow, for example new, assigned or completed.
submitted_at: Date and time the requester submitted the service request.
completed_on: Date the core facility finished the work; empty while the request is still open.
owner.name: Full name of the person who submitted the request.
owner.email: Email address of the person who submitted the request.
owner.phone: Telephone number of the person who submitted the request.
lab.name: Name of the research lab the requester belongs to.
lab.principal_investigators: Principal investigators who lead the requester's lab and are responsible for the project.
customer_institution.name: University or institute the customer is affiliated with.
assigned_to: Core facility staff assigned to carry out the request.
service_name: The specific service ordered from the core facility.
category_name: Broad category the service belongs to, such as proteomics or metabolomics.
projected_cost: Estimated price of the service before the work starts.
form.number_of_samples: Number of samples the requester plans to send for analysis.
form.sample_type: Kind of biological material in the samples, such as tissue, cells or plasma.
form.background: Background of the research project and the aim of the analysis.
actions.show_request.url: API URL used to fetch this service request over HTTP.
actions.show_request.method: HTTP method used when calling the API endpoint that shows the request.

request_id: Identifier the ordering system assigns to each service request.
request_name: Title describing what the service request is about.
status: Where the request stands in the facility workflow, for example waiting, assigned or done.
submission_date: Day the service request was sent to the facility.
completion_date: Day the facility completed the requested work, if it has.
requester.full_name: Name of the researcher who placed the request.
requester.email: Contact email of the researcher who placed the request.
requester.phone_number: Phone number to reach the researcher who placed the request.
research_group: Research group that the requester works in.
pi_name: Name of the principal investigator who leads the research group.
institution: Organisation, such as a university, that the requester comes from.
assignee: Staff member at the facility responsible for the request.
service: Name of the analysis service being requested.
category: Type of analysis the service falls under, such as proteomics.
estimated_cost: Cost the facility expects to charge for the work.
samples.count: How many samples will be submitted.
samples.type: What the samples are made of, for example tissue or cells, and how they were prepared.
project.description: Short description of the research project and what the analysis should show.
links.self: Web API link that returns this request as JSON over HTTP.

id: Numeric identifier of the service request.
title: Name given to the service request by the customer.
state: Processing state of the request, for example new, processing or cancelled.
submitted_on: Timestamp when the customer submitted the request.
completed_on: Date the work on the request was completed; empty if not yet done.
customer.name: Name of the customer who ordered the service.
customer.e_mail: E-mail address used to contact the customer.
lab.name: Laboratory where the customer works.
lab.pi: Head of the laboratory, the principal investigator.
affiliation: Institution the customer is affiliated with.
assigned_to: Facility staff the request has been assigned to.
service_type: Kind of service requested from the facility.
service_category: Category of the requested service, such as metabolomics.
cost_estimate: Quoted estimate of what the service will cost.
n_samples: Number of samples in the request.
sample_type: Biological material the samples consist of, such as plasma or tissue.
summary: Summary of the project and the question the analysis should answer.
api_url: URL of the API endpoint for this request.
http_method: HTTP verb used for the API call, such as GET.

sr_id: Service request identifier used by the facility's ordering system.
service_request.name: Name of the service request as entered by the requester.
request_status: Status of the request in the facility workflow, such as new, in progress or completed.
created_at: When the service request was first created.
finished_at: When the facility finished the work on the request.
owner.name: Name of the person who owns the request.
owner.email_address: Email address of the person who owns the request.
owner.telephone: Telephone number of the person who owns the request.
laboratory: Research laboratory the request owner belongs to.
principal_investigator: Principal investigator responsible for the research and its funding.
customer_institution.name: Name of the customer's university or research institute.
staff.assigned: Facility staff member who handles the request.
projected_cost: Projected cost of the service, quoted before the work.
number_of_samples: Total number of samples to analyse.
type_of_samples: Type of samples supplied, such as gel bands, cells or tissue.
project_background: Scientific background of the project and what the analysis is for.
actions.show_request.url: API URL that returns this service request.
actions.show_request.method: HTTP method for the show-request API call.

identifier: Reference code that uniquely identifies the request.
name: Title of the service request.
workflow.state: Stage the request has reached in the workflow, such as submitted, active or cancelled.
dates.completed: Date the request was completed, if it has been.
contact.name: Name of the contact person for the request.
contact.email: Email of the contact person for the request.
contact.phone: Phone number of the contact person for the request.
group.name: Name of the research group making the request.
group.leader: Leader of the research group, usually the principal investigator.
organisation: University, hospital or institute the research group belongs to.
handled_by: Facility staff member handling the request, if one has been assigned.
requested_service: Service the group asked the facility to perform.
category_name: Category of the service, for example lipidomics or proteomics.
quote.amount: Amount quoted to the customer for the service.
sample_number: Number of samples that will be delivered.
material: Sample material, such as cultures, tissue or plasma, and its preparation.
aim: Aim of the project and what the measurements should reveal.
href: Hyperlink to this request in the web API.
